entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hello... yes, I think I need to make a return. I bought these shoes and I'm just so confused by the whole process. I don't know what I'm supposed to do.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, I... I'm not sure what you mean. They're your special **cycling shoes**. I tried them a few times but they feel all wrong and I think I'm getting **blisters** near my heel. And the **cleats** are so confusing to attach. I just want a **refund**. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear they aren't comfortable for you. Let's see what we can do. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Garcia. The order number is... hold on... VF-8872-6501.
Thank you, Maria. One moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see the order here. You received them 49 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure what the rules were. It's so overwhelming.
Not at all. You are well within our 90-day return window for this item. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's such a relief. So I can send them back?

Absolutely. I've just started the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you as we speak with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue your full refund to the original payment method.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. I really appreciate you making that so easy. I was so worried.
It's my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
